title.zh: Crypto industry groups escalate fight against Illinois, asking court to block controversial crypto tax
title.en: Crypto industry groups escalate fight against Illinois, asking court to block controversial crypto tax

current_state.zh: Crypto industry groups have escalated their legal fight against Illinois, seeking a preliminary injunction to block the state's 0.2% crypto transaction tax before it takes effect in January 2027, citing constitutional violations and compliance burdens.
current_state.en: Crypto industry groups have escalated their legal fight against Illinois, seeking a preliminary injunction to block the state's 0.2% crypto transaction tax before it takes effect in January 2027, citing constitutional violations and compliance burdens.
